high.title: MTS 1, Software Engineer - Full Stack
high.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Join eBay’s Advertising and Marketing Technology teams to build the platforms, services, and user experiences that help sellers grow their business and make eBay the destination website for existing and new customers. You’ll work on high-scale systems spanning frontend applications, backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and AI-assisted engineering workflows, partnering closely with product, design, analytics, and applied science. We’re looking for engineers who can turn business problems into reliable, maintainable software, make sound technical tradeoffs, and take ownership from design through production. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving practical engineering problems in a fast-moving environment where performance, quality, and measurable customer impact matter.

Job Responsibilities



- Design and build innovative advertising, marketing platform features that help eBay sellers, advertisers grow their business and help eBay become the dominant eCommerce platform.
- Develop scalable, highly available applications, APIs, and services using technologies such as Marko, React, Node.js, Java, and Scala.
- Own end-to-end delivery of complex features, from technical design and architecture through deployment and production support.
- Drive technical decisions, system design, and cross-team collaboration to ensure scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions.
- Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) throughout the development lifecycle for coding, debugging, testing, and code review to increase engineering velocity.
- Contribute to AI-powered advertising and marketing features by collaborating with ML engineers on LLM integrations, recommendation systems, and intelligent campaign optimization.
- Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, Agile development, open-source collaboration, and rapid software delivery.
- Mentor team members, participate in technical discussions, and help shape engineering best practices across the organization.


Job Requirements



- BS/BA in Computer Science or related field plus 7 years work experience or MS with 6 years of relevant experience.
- Strong experience in building modern web applications at scale with React (or similar frameworks), HTML/CSS, RESTful APIs and responsive design.
- Experience with relational (Oracle/Postgres/MySQL) and/or NoSQL (Cassandra/MongoDB) databases, including schema design and query optimization.
- Proven ability to own end-to-end system design: writing technical design documents, leading design reviews, and making architectural decisions for multi-service features.
- Experience designing scalable distributed systems with a track record of evaluating trade-offs (consistency, availability, latency, cost) and driving technical alignment across teams.
- Experience with AI-assisted development practices and tools to increase engineering productivity (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent).
- Experience building or integrating LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, or AI-driven automation in production systems is a plus.
- Strong ownership mentality with ability to drive work end-to-end in a collaborative environment.
- Exposure to GraphQL and experience in building Federated GraphQL APIs is highly desirable.
- Experience on contributing to open-source is a plus.


Benefits are an essential part of your total compensation for the work you do every day. Whether you’re single, in a growing family, or nearing retirement, eBay offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefit programs to meet your needs. Including maternal & paternal leave, paid sabbatical, and plans to help ensure your financial security today and in the years ahead because we know feeling financially secure during your working years and through retirement is important.

Here at eBay, we love creating opportunities for others by connecting people from widely diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and geographies. So, being diverse and inclusive isn’t just something we strive for, it is who we are, and part of what we do each and every single day. We want to ensure that as an employee, you feel eBay is a place where, no matter who you are, you feel safe, included, and that you have the opportunity to bring your unique self to work. To learn about eBay’s Diversity & Inclusion click here: https://www.ebayinc.com/our-company/diversity-inclusion/

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

high.title: Agentic AI Java Developer
high.description:
About PeopleHum

peopleHum is a Human Capital Platform built for the next decade. We are on a mission to transform “The Future of Work.” Winner of the 2019 Global CODiE Award, peopleHum is used by organizations around the world.

It is an intuitive, agile, and integrated platform built for a complete multi-generational employee experience, from hiring to performance, engagement, and HRMS, powered by machine learning and automation.

Find out more: https://www.peoplehum.com

Role Overview

peopleHum is an AI-native human capital global platform built on a microservices architecture with event-driven pipelines and deep LLM integrations on the Java stack. We are looking for a Backend Developer with 0–1 years of experience who is eager to build strong backend engineering skills across Java, Spring Boot, APIs, databases, microservices, and AI-powered systems.This is not a narrow coding role. You will work across the backend stack, collaborate closely with frontend, QA, and product teams, and learn how production-grade enterprise applications are designed, built, deployed, monitored, and improved. Exposure to Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, databases, or AI/LLM concepts is preferred. Curiosity about Agentic AI systems, LLM orchestration, RAG pipelines, and autonomous agents will be a strong advantage.

Key Responsibilities

Ownership & Accountability:



- Take ownership of assigned backend tasks from understanding requirements to delivering working code
- Learn to think beyond tickets by understanding how your work impacts the product and users
- Write clean, maintainable, and testable code with guidance from senior engineers
- Participate in debugging, deployment, monitoring, and fixing issues in your own code
- Develop accountability for quality, correctness, and timely delivery

Communication & Collaboration



- Communicate clearly with your team about progress, blockers, and technical questions
- Collaborate with frontend, QA, product, and design teams to understand requirements and edge cases
- Participate actively in sprint discussions, code reviews, and technical discussions
- Share learnings, document work where needed, and be open to feedback

Problem-Solving & Critical Thinking



- Break down problems into smaller, solvable parts
- Understand the business context behind technical tasks
- Learn to think about reliability, security, performance, and correctness while building backend systems
- Debug issues systematically and ask thoughtful questions when stuck

Growth Mindset & Learning Agility



- Stay curious and continuously learn backend engineering best practices
- Build familiarity with emerging technologies, especially AI, LLMs, and automation
- Be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities
- Learn quickly from code reviews, production issues, and team feedback

Autonomy & Initiative



- Deliver assigned work with increasing independence
- Ask smart questions, unblock yourself, and escalate issues when needed
- Show initiative in improving code quality, learning new tools, and understanding system design
- Balance speed with clean implementation and long-term maintainability

Must have skills



- Basic to good understanding of Java and object-oriented programming
- Exposure to Spring Boot and building RESTful APIs
- Understanding of backend concepts such as APIs, services, request-response flow, error handling, and logging
- Basic knowledge of SQL databases such as MariaDB or MySQL
- Familiarity with data structures, algorithms, and problem-solving fundamentals
- Understanding of clean code practices and willingness to follow engineering standards
- Basic awareness of microservices, event-driven systems, or distributed backend architecture
- Strong interest in AI/LLM-based systems, agentic AI patterns, RAG pipelines, or automation workflows
- Good communication skills, ownership mindset, and willingness to learn fast

Good to have skills



- Exposure to MongoDB, Redis, or Elasticsearch
- Basic understanding of authentication and authorization concepts
- Familiarity with tools such as Maven, Git, JUnit, or SonarQube
- Awareness of observability, monitoring, logging, or alerting tools
- Understanding of service discovery, secrets management, or distributed system basics
- Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, LangChain, or similar AI frameworks
- Exposure to langchain-core, langchain-community, or langchain-elasticsearch is a plus

medium.title: Full Stack Developer – Node.js, React.js, TypeScript & AI-Assisted Development
medium.description:
Job Summary

Synechron is seeking a Full Stack Developer with strong expertise in Node.js and React.js to design, develop, test, and maintain scalable full-stack applications. The role requires hands-on experience with TypeScript, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and NoSQL databases, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and AI code generation tools.The successful candidate will use AI-assisted development tools, including GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools, to improve development efficiency while applying appropriate review, testing, security, and quality controls. The role contributes to business objectives by delivering reliable software, responsive user interfaces, scalable services, and maintainable technology solutions.

Required

Software Requirements



- 3+ years of professional experience in full-stack development. 
- Strong proficiency in Node.js using Express, NestJS, or similar frameworks. 
- Strong proficiency in React.js, including:

- React Hooks
- State management
- Component architecture
- Responsive and performant user interface development
- Experience with TypeScript. 
- Hands-on experience with AI code generation tools, including GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools. 
- Understanding of prompt engineering for coding tasks. 
- Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis. 
- Experience with Git version control and branching strategies. 
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines. 
- Understanding of RESTful API design and best practices. 
- Ability to write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well-tested code. 
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging production issues. 

Preferred



- Experience building scalable RESTful APIs and microservices in production environments. 
- Experience with advanced Node.js and React.js application architecture. 
- Familiarity with automated testing, static analysis, dependency checks, and performance testing. 
- Exposure to cloud-based application deployment and monitoring. 
- Experience with containerized applications and automated deployment environments. 
- Familiarity with responsible AI-assisted development practices, including reviewing generated code for correctness, security, privacy, and maintainability. 
- Experience improving development workflows through automation and reusable components. 

Overall Responsibilities



- Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack applications using Node.js, React.js, and TypeScript. 
- Build scalable RESTful APIs and microservices using Express, NestJS, or similar Node.js frameworks. 
- Develop responsive, accessible, and performant user interfaces using React.js. 
- Apply React Hooks, state management, and component architecture to create maintainable frontend solutions. 
- Integrate and effectively utilize AI code generation tools to accelerate development workflows. 
- Apply prompt engineering techniques for coding tasks and validate AI-generated output through code review, testing, security checks, and functional verification. 
- Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well-tested code. 
- Work with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and other SQL or NoSQL data stores as required. 
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, refine, implement, and validate features. 
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices, coding standards, documentation, and knowledge sharing. 
- Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines that support consistent build, testing, and deployment activities. 
- Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve application, integration, performance, and production issues. 
- Contribute to improvements in software quality, application performance, development efficiency, and operational reliability. 
- Promote sustainable engineering practices through reusable components, efficient processing, appropriate technology use, and reduced rework. 
- Deliver software solutions that meet agreed requirements for functionality, maintainability, performance, security, and quality. 

Strategic Objectives



- Deliver scalable, reliable, and maintainable full-stack applications using Node.js and React.js. 
- Improve development efficiency through effective and responsible use of AI code generation tools. 
- Build RESTful APIs, microservices, and user interfaces that support evolving business requirements. 
- Strengthen engineering quality through testing, code reviews, CI/CD, documentation, and consistent development practices. 
- Improve application stability, performance, usability, and production support outcomes. 

Performance Outcomes



- Features and enhancements are delivered within agreed timelines and quality expectations. 
- APIs, microservices, and frontend applications meet defined requirements for performance, scalability, and maintainability. 
- AI-assisted code is reviewed, tested, secured, and integrated according to engineering standards. 
- Production defects and performance issues are investigated and resolved within agreed service expectations. 
- CI/CD pipelines support repeatable and reliable build, testing, and deployment processes. 
- Technical decisions, code, tests, and operational procedures are documented clearly and maintained appropriately. 

Technical Skills (By Category)

Programming Languages

Essential



- Strong Node.js development experience. 
- Strong proficiency in TypeScript. 
- Working knowledge of JavaScript for full-stack application development. 
- Ability to write modular, readable, maintainable, and testable code. 
- Understanding of asynchronous programming, error handling, API integration, and application performance. 

Preferred



- Experience with modern JavaScript language features and application development patterns. 
- Familiarity with scripting for automation, testing, or development-support activities. 

Databases/Data Management

Essential



- Proficiency in SQL databases, particularly PostgreSQL. 
- Proficiency in NoSQL databases, particularly MongoDB. 
- Experience using Redis for caching, session management, data access, or related application needs. 
- Understanding of data modeling, querying, indexing, transactions, validation, and data integrity. 
- Ability to design and maintain data-access patterns that support performance and scalability. 

Preferred



- Experience working with multiple database technologies in distributed applications. 
- Familiarity with database performance monitoring, migration, backup, recovery, and optimization. 
- Exposure to caching strategies and data-consistency considerations in microservices environments. 

Cloud Technologies

Essential



- Understanding of deploying and operating full-stack applications in cloud or enterprise environments. 
- Awareness of application scalability, availability, monitoring, access control, and resource management. 

Preferred



- Experience with cloud-based application deployment and managed database services. 
- Familiarity with containers, orchestration, cloud networking, storage, and application monitoring. 
- Experience optimizing application and cloud resource usage to support efficient and sustainable technology delivery. 

Frameworks and Libraries

Essential



- Node.js with Express, NestJS, or a similar framework. 
- React.js with Hooks, state management, and component architecture. 
- TypeScript-based frontend and backend development. 
- Experience building scalable RESTful APIs. 
- Understanding of microservices architecture and service integration. 
- Ability to develop responsive and performant user interfaces. 

Preferred



- Experience with frontend component libraries, routing, form handling, validation, and performance optimization. 
- Familiarity with API documentation, asynchronous processing, messaging, or distributed application tools. 
- Exposure to reusable design systems and accessibility-focused frontend development. 

Development Tools and Methodologies

Essential



- Git version control and branching strategies. 
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing, and deployment. 
- Experience with code reviews, defect resolution, technical documentation, and collaborative development. 
- Understanding of software development lifecycle practices. 
- Ability to work with cross-functional teams to define and deliver features. 
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging production issues. 
- Hands-on experience using AI code generation tools and prompt engineering for coding tasks. 

Preferred



- Experience integrating AI-assisted development into testing, documentation, refactoring, debugging, or code-generation workflows. 
- Familiarity with automated testing, static analysis, dependency scanning, and performance testing. 
- Exposure to Agile or iterative software development practices. 
- Experience with containerization and automated deployment environments. 

Security Protocols

Essential



- Understanding of secure coding practices for Node.js, React.js, TypeScript, RESTful APIs, and microservices. 
- Knowledge of authentication, authorization, access controls, input validation, secure API design, and protection of sensitive data. 
- Ability to review AI-generated code for security, privacy, quality, correctness, and maintainability. 
- Awareness of dependency management, secrets protection, secure configuration, and vulnerability remediation. 

Preferred



- Experience integrating security checks into CI/CD pipelines. 
- Familiarity with application security testing, threat modeling, secure headers, encryption, and API security controls. 
- Experience applying responsible AI-assisted development practices to protect source code and sensitive information. 

Experience Requirements



- 3+ years of professional experience in full-stack development. 
- Strong practical experience developing applications using Node.js, React.js, and TypeScript. 
- Demonstrable experience building scalable RESTful APIs and microservices. 
- Experience developing responsive, performant, and maintainable React.js user interfaces. 
- Hands-on experience with AI code generation tools and prompt engineering for coding tasks. 
- Experience working with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, or comparable SQL and NoSQL databases. 
- Experience with Git, version control, CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, testing, and production troubleshooting. 
- Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to define and implement software features. 
- Candidates may qualify through equivalent hands-on full-stack development experience, significant project delivery, or a portfolio demonstrating the required Node.js, React.js, TypeScript, database, API, and AI-assisted development skills. 

Day-to-Day Activities



- Design, develop, test, and maintain Node.js services, RESTful APIs, microservices, React.js interfaces, TypeScript components, and database integrations. 
- Participate in requirements discussions, planning sessions, technical design reviews, code reviews, delivery coordination, and collaboration with cross-functional teams. 
- Deliver tested application features, API changes, reusable components, CI/CD updates, technical documentation, defect fixes, and production support outcomes. 
- Make technical decisions within the assigned scope, use AI code generation tools responsibly, validate implementation quality, troubleshoot issues, and escalate risks or dependencies appropriately. 

Qualifications



- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may also be considered. 
- 3+ years of full-stack development experience with demonstrated delivery using Node.js, React.js, TypeScript, RESTful APIs, and SQL/NoSQL databases. 
- Relevant training in Node.js, React.js, TypeScript, databases, RESTful APIs, microservices, CI/CD, software testing, or AI-assisted development is preferred. 
- Certifications in cloud, software development, databases, DevOps, or related technologies are preferred but are not mandatory unless required for a specific assignment. 
- Maintain continuous professional development in full-stack engineering, AI code generation, prompt engineering, application security, testing, cloud technologies, and modern development practices. 

Professional Competencies



- Apply critical thinking, structured analysis, and practical problem-solving to resolve application, API, database, performance, and production issues. 
- Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and contribute to code reviews, engineering standards, knowledge sharing, and delivery outcomes. 
- Communicate technical requirements, implementation decisions, risks, progress, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
- Adapt to changing requirements, technologies, development practices, and delivery priorities while maintaining code quality and reliability. 
- Identify opportunities to improve application architecture, user experience, development efficiency, automation, reusability, security, and sustainable technology use. 
- Prioritize and manage development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and deployment activities while meeting agreed timelines.

Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiative ‘Same Difference’ is committed to fostering an inclusive culture – promoting equality, diversity and an environment that is respectful to all. Introduction

Job Title: Apprentice Engineer, R&D Development Team

Department: R&D Development

SymphonyAI is a leading enterprise AI solutions provider helping retailers and manufacturers optimize business operations through advanced analytics, planning, and automation solutions. Our products support global organizations in improving supply chain efficiency, inventory performance, forecasting accuracy, and customer satisfaction. We are committed to delivering measurable outcomes for our clients through innovative technology, deep domain expertise, and strong customer partnerships.

About the Role:

We are seeking highly motivated Apprentice Engineers to join our R&D Development Team, working on next-generation Category Planning and Retail Analytics platforms. This apprenticeship provides hands-on exposure to:



- Enterprise-grade web applications
- Data-driven retail solutions
- Modern cloud-native architectures
- Emerging AI / Agentic workflows

You will collaborate with experienced engineers and contribute to real-world product development across modules such as Assortment Optimization, Planogram Automation, Space Analytics, and Category Insights

Diversity & Inclusion Statement:

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

medium.title: Software Engineer II
medium.description:
Role Description

Why Join 7-Eleven Global Solution Center?

When you join us, you'll embrace ownership as teams within specific product areas take responsibility for end-to-end solution delivery, supporting local teams and integrating new digital assets. Challenge yourself by contributing to products deployed across our extensive network of convenience stores, processing over a billion transactions annually. Build solutions for scale, addressing the diverse needs of our 84,000+ stores in 19 countries. Experience growth through cross-functional learning, encouraged and applauded at 7-Eleven GSC. With our size, stability, and resources, you can navigate a rewarding career. Embody leadership and service as 7-Eleven GSC remains dedicated to meeting the needs of customers and communities.

Why We Exist, Our Purpose and Our Transformation?

7-Eleven is dedicated to being a customer-centric, digitally empowered organization that seamlessly integrates our physical stores with digital offerings. Our goal is to redefine convenience by consistently providing top-notch customer experiences and solutions in a rapidly evolving consumer landscape. Anticipating customer preferences, we create and implement platforms that empower customers to shop, pay, and access products and services according to their preferences. To achieve success, we are driving a cultural shift anchored in leadership principles, supported by the realignment of organizational resources and processes.

At 7-Eleven we are guided by our Leadership Principles. Each principle has a defined set of behaviours which help guide the 7-Eleven GSC team to Serve Customers and Support Stores.



-  Be Customer Obsessed
-  Be Courageous with Your Point of View
-  Challenge the Status Quo
-  Act Like an Entrepreneur
-  Have an “It Can Be Done” Attitude
-  Do the Right Thing
-  Be Accountable

About This Opportunity

Job Title: Software Engineer II

Location: Bengaluru, India

Responsibilities



- Design, develop, and maintain web applications using the MERN stack.
- Build, integrate, and deploy applications on AWS cloud infrastructure.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable solutions.
- Develop clean, efficient, and maintainable front-end and back-end code.
- Utilize AWS services for compute, storage, and application infrastructure requirements.
- Work with MongoDB and other databases to store, manage, and retrieve data.
- Ensure application security, scalability, performance, and availability.
- Troubleshoot and resolve issues across application and cloud infrastructure layers.
- Define and implement AWS architecture and development best practices.
- Partner with architects and developers to create supportable designs and solve complex technical problems.
- Support critical production incidents and drive timely issue resolution when escalation is not feasible.
- Create and maintain system documentation, runbooks, procedures, and knowledge-sharing materials.
- Monitor application and infrastructure health using logging and monitoring tools.
- Stay informed on cloud computing technologies, business drivers, and emerging industry trends.

Responsibilities



- Proven experience as a MERN Stack Developer with AWS cloud expertise.
- Strong proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, React.js (Class and Functional Components), Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB.
- Hands-on experience with AWS services such as EC2, Kinesis, S3, Lambda, and API Gateway.
- Strong knowledge of Git, Webpack, Babel, and modern front-end development toolchains.
- Experience designing and implementing serverless and microservices-based architectures on AWS.
- Hands-on experience with AWS deployment and infrastructure management tools, including AWS CLI and CloudFormation.
- Familiarity with Jenkins, DevOps practices, and CI/CD pipeline implementation.
- Ability to optimize applications for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.

stretch.title: Senior Full Stack Developer - Node.js/React.js
stretch.description:
About The Role

This is not a role where you maintain a dashboard and close tickets. We build AI-native enterprise software. Real-time multilingual voice, heavy data pipelines, multi-tenant systems, and interfaces that thousands of people sit inside all day, across India, the UK and Europe.

The work is hard in the way good engineering work is hard. Latency budgets you actually have to hit. Queries that fall apart at scale unless you think about them properly. UI that has to stay responsive while streaming data in from three places at once.

If you like being handed a spec and told what to type, this will not suit you. If you like owning a hard problem end to end and being the person accountable for it, keep reading.

What You'll Be Doing

On the backend:



-  Design and own services in Node and TypeScript, sitting on PostgreSQL.
-  Model data properly. Normalised where it matters, denormalised where it earns you something. You should be comfortable reasoning about foreign keys, partial and composite indexes, and what a covering index actually buys you.
-  Read query plans. Kill N+1s. Understand connection pooling, transaction isolation levels, advisory locks, and why a long-running transaction on a hot table ruins everyone's afternoon.
-  Build multi-tenant boundaries that hold. Tenant scoping, RBAC, row-level isolation, audit trails. Getting this wrong in enterprise software is not a bug, it is an incident.
-  Work with event-driven flows. Queues, workers, retries with backoff, idempotency keys, dead letter handling, backpressure. Exactly-once is a lie, design for at-least-once and make it safe.
-  Caching that is actually correct. Cache-aside patterns, TTL strategy, stampede protection, distributed locks, and knowing when invalidation is the wrong answer.
-  Real-time paths. SSE and WebSockets, streaming responses, connection lifecycle, reconnection semantics.
-  Integrate with enterprise systems designed in a different decade. Legacy file transfer, XML and SOAP-ish APIs, webhook contracts, OAuth flows, rate limits you do not control.

On The Frontend



-  Build in React and TypeScript on a modern Next.js setup. Server components, client components, and a clear head about which does what and why.
-  Streaming SSR, suspense boundaries, route-level code splitting, and hydration behaviour you can explain rather than guess at.
-  Own Core Web Vitals. LCP, INP, CLS. Bundle analysis, dependency pruning, font and image strategy, no waterfalls in the data layer.
-  Complex stateful UI. Server state in a proper query cache, client state kept minimal, optimistic updates, race condition handling, stale data reconciliation.
-  Data-dense interfaces done well. Virtualised tables, infinite scroll, filter and sort state in the URL, forms with schema validation on both sides of the wire.
-  Real-time UI that does not thrash. Streaming tokens, live status, presence, without re-rendering the world every tick.
-  A design system that stays consistent. Typed component APIs, sensible primitives, accessibility that is not an afterthought.

Across Both



-  Own features from schema to screen. You design the tables, write the API, build the UI, ship it, and watch what happens after.
-  Review code seriously and push back when something is wrong.
-  Argue about what to build, not just how.

The Kind Of Stack You'll Be In



-  Languages: TypeScript end to end, SQL.
-  Frontend: React, Next.js, a component library, utility CSS, schema validation.
-  Backend: Node.js, a lightweight HTTP framework, a typed query layer, REST and streaming APIs.
-  Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, object storage.
-  Cloud: AWS across multiple regions. Serverless functions, managed queues, CDN, managed Postgres and cache.
-  AI layer: LLM APIs, function calling, streaming inference, real-time voice.

You do not need every one of these on your CV. You do need to be the kind of engineer who picks up a new one over a weekend and is useful on Monday.

What We're Looking For



-  5 to 7 years building production web systems. Real users, real load, real consequences when it breaks.
-  Deep TypeScript. Generics, discriminated unions, inference. You use the type system to prevent bugs, not to decorate the code.
-  Strong React. You know why a component re-rendered and how to stop it. You know when memoisation helps and when it is cargo cult.
-  Genuinely comfortable in a database. You can write the SQL yourself and you know what the ORM is doing when you don't.
-  You have designed an API someone else had to consume and it held up.
-  You have debugged something in production under pressure and written up what went wrong afterwards.
-  You write code a stranger can read in six months.

On background: We lean towards engineers who have worked at a startup where they had to own a lot without a playbook, or who come from a strong engineering school (IIT, NIT, BITS, IIIT and similar). Both is ideal. Neither is a dealbreaker if the work speaks loudly enough. Send the GitHub, the side project, the thing that got used.

Nice To Have



-  Worked with LLM APIs, streaming completions, prompt and eval design, or real-time voice.
-  Built multi-tenant B2B SaaS with enterprise customers.
-  Performance work you can talk about specifically. What was slow, what you measured, what you changed.
-  Open source contributions, or a technical blog where you explain things properly.
-  You have been the first or second engineer on something.

What Working Here Is Like



-  Fast. Really fast. Decisions get made in one conversation, not across weeks of meetings. There is no ticket queue you sit in. If you see something broken you fix it.
-  You get the whole picture. Founders sit in the same room. You will know what we are prioritising and why.
-  The flip side is ownership. Nobody chases you for status. Ship it, tell the team, move on.

What You Get



-  Competitive salary, benchmarked properly for senior engineers in Bengaluru.
-  Real ownership of systems that carry weight, not a slice of someone else's feature.
-  Hard problems, short feedback loops, and no layers between you and the outcome.
-  A team where you will not be the smartest person in the room every day.
